name: SIM Approve Vote
description: Test fixture for the yes-or-no vote: a secret hand-out collect (four states), a vote where every student says yes or no to every clause, and a reveal of the clauses that passed. Underscore-prefixed so it never appears in game lists. Driven by scripts/simulate-approve-vote.js.

ask.prompt: You represent {{ask.assigned}}. Write one clause your state needs in the constitution.
